name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Record Binance theft; alert apps hacked in Russia and Ukraine on 2 Nov
state: The FBI said on 1 Nov that North Korea stole about $6.3bn from Binance in late October, the largest crypto theft on record; Binance says it has replaced about 95% of the stolen assets (2 Nov). On 2 Nov Russia's emergency warning app and Ukraine's Air Alarm app were both hit, sending false alerts (PBS). The Pentagon is investigating refrigeration failures at US commissaries as a possible cyberattack (Fortune, 1 Nov).
for_you: Be alert to phishing linked to data-breach news; NCSC guidance covers how to protect accounts.
rubric_hit: Attacks disrupting a major exchange and public services = Watch; none national-scale

sources.title: Help Net Security — FBI pins $6.3 billion Binance heist on North Korea
PBS NewsHour — Ukraine and Russia both report fake emergency alerts after cyberattacks
Fortune — Hackers pushed freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
